text:
zoe: deploy-bot paused the promotion for tag=release-2026.08.03 — 3/6 staging canaries failing during db-migration-smoke.

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.08.03, reason=integration-tests/db-migration-smoke x3 failures"

paul: seeing mkdir conflicts in runner restore + migration lock timeouts in the same job. snippet: ```ERROR: mkdir /tmp/ws/run-312: file exists
Timeout acquiring migration lock for step 0001_create_customers```

emma: logs show two parallel test runners hitting the same namespace prefix `ci-run-` due to recent change in job naming. They both try to create the same DB namespace and stomp.

infra-ops: we rolled a change last night that trimmed the random suffix length for job names (to make debugging easier). That reduced entropy — likely the root cause. Rolling back would be quick but still needs testing.

qa-lina: change window closes in 45m. If we don't unblock, prod cut will be blocked. Options: pin previous prod image (release-2026.07.27), rerun canaries serialized after reverting the job-name change (adds ~30m), or extend window. Thoughts?

paul: pinning is lowest risk to meet the window. Revert+rerun is better long term but might miss the window. Also need an incident to track the job-name regression.

release-mgr: agree pin for the cut. Open a follow-up ENG-4999 for the job-name entropy regression and runner collisions. We'll schedule a serialized rerun tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: recommendation: `pin_previous_image` when canary pass rate < 70% or infra-level namespace collisions detected.

zoe: decision: manual promote to release-2026.07.27 to unblock. I'll own ENG-4999 and coordinate infra revert + rerun.Can someone draft the release-note blurb?

paul: draft posted in #release-notes-drafts: "Production cut pinned to 2026.07.27 after staging DB migration namespace collisions caused by reduced job-name entropy. ENG-4999 opened for follow-up."

release-mgr: invoking deploy-bot: `promote --image=release-2026.07.27 --reason="staging-db-namespace-collision"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-ops: I'll prepare the revert PR for the job-name change and tag it ENG-4999. We should also add a preflight check to the CI that verifies namespace uniqueness length >= 8.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production now points to release-2026.07.27. :white_check_mark:

zoe: ENG-4999 created and assigned to infra-ops. Follow-ups: revert job-name change, add namespace uniqueness check, schedule serialized rerun 10:00 UTC tomorrow. Close thread after ENG-4999 has initial RCA attached. :lock:
